title: Strict circuit conversion
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs in which every gate has distinct arguments and at most two arguments, and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. There is a circuit $C'$ on the same inputs that computes the same Boolean function, in which every gate has distinct arguments and exactly one argument for a NOT gate or two for an AND or OR gate, and every vertex other than the output has positive fanout; moreover, $C'$ has size at most $4$ times the size of $C$ plus $12$.
hypotheses_covered: Every NOT gate has one argument
